sections.heading: Overview
paragraphs: ITC India provides mechanical testing support across product safety, durability and materials programmes. Use the service links below to open each dedicated page for scope, method and enquiry.

sections.heading: Mechanical Testing Services
paragraphs: These are the mechanical testing programmes listed on this page — eight service links, each opening its dedicated laboratory or article page.
bullets: All about masks — overview of mask types, materials and testing considerations.
Understanding Quality Of Masks — how mask quality is assessed for performance and consistency.
Safety Testing Of Masks — safety testing for face shields, masks and respirators.
CE marking Of Masks — CE marking support for face mask products.
Cable Gland Testing — mechanical and environmental evaluation of cable glands.
Vibration Testing — vibration and dynamic mechanical testing programmes.
Cable Tray Testing — cable tray strength, load and laboratory testing.
Corrosion Testing — corrosion and environmental durability testing.
